description: Gives every agent its own logo, so custom ACP agents stop sharing one generic icon. Pick a mark per provider from the sidebar or the bb model-favicons command, and nine bundled marks cover GLM, Kimi, MiniMax Code, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Claude, Codex, and Gemini. Applies in the model picker and every provider list, in light and dark. Needs BB 0.49 or newer and a configured ACP provider.
